_about: Acids and bases for chapter 14 fixed problems. GROUND OF TRUTH (instructor, 13 Oct 2026): OpenStax Chemistry 2e first (Appendix H for Ka, Appendix I for Kb), NIST only where the text has no value. Every value carries its source; a value marked 'instructor confirms' has not yet been checked against the text by the instructor.
